title: The Hallucination Hunt
description: Deliberately probe AI for hallucinations on a topic you know well — and build a sharper intuition for catching them.
steps: Choose a topic you know well — your industry, a hobby, a city you know deeply
Ask AI 10 specific factual questions on that topic
Record every answer before looking anything up
Verify each answer against a reliable source
Document: which type of facts had the most errors? What patterns do you notice?
expectedOutput: A hallucination audit with score, error patterns identified, and personal rules for when to verify AI output.
bonusChallenges: Compare hallucination rates between two different models on the same questions
Test Perplexity vs ChatGPT — does citations reduce error rate?
